# Vendor Asset Manifest

## Quaternius Medieval Village Pack

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillage.html
- Stated license on source page: free to use in personal and commercial projects.
- Local path: `assets/vendor/quaternius-medieval-village/`
- Used for Deston's Trading Post:
  - `Buildings/FBX/Inn.fbx` -> Deston's Hall footprint
  - `Buildings/FBX/House_2.fbx` -> Guesthouse footprint
  - `Buildings/FBX/Stable.fbx` -> Stable footprint
  - `Props/Blends/MarketStand_1.blend` -> Market yard stands
  - Additional downloaded props are available for future placement.
